title: Buyer beware
text: Buyer beware. I chose this product to gift to a person who has a hard time opening containers. I tried it with the person after having to review instructions on how use to use it because it did not come with any instructions. It is a little tricky to use the videos I watched make the items look easy to use and work perfectly which is not true at all you have to figure it out yourself. The deceptive advertising of this product does not impress me because it is not honest to people who need this product. Construction of the items included is not great which is disappointing because they are not worth what I paid for them. No I would not suggest this product to anybody unless they are specifically looking for over priced mass produced cheap imported inferior quality tools.
